assignees.description: Filters the returned cases by assignees. Valid values are `none` or unique identifiers for the user profiles. These identifiers can be found by using the suggest user profile API.

category.description: Filters the returned cases by category.

defaultSearchOperator.description: he default operator to use for the simple_query_string.

from.description: Returns only cases that were created after a specific date. The date must be specified as a KQL data range or date match expression.

owner.description: A filter to limit the response to a specific set of applications. If this parameter is omitted, the response contains information about all the cases that the user has access to read.

perPage.description: The number of items to return. Limited to 100 items.

reporters.description: Filters the returned cases by the user name of the reporter.

search.description: An Elasticsearch simple_query_string query that filters the objects in the response.

searchFields.description: The fields to perform the simple_query_string parsed query against.

sortField.description: Determines which field is used to sort the results.

status.description: Filters the returned cases by state.

tags.description: Filters the returned cases by tags.

to.description: Returns only cases that were created before a specific date. The date must be specified as a KQL data range or date match expression.
